card.name: Spelled-out numbers four to nine
card.fires_on: Spelled-out count words such as three, four, six or eight in dosing text, usually before 'times', 'tablets' or '-fold'. It fires on the number word itself, not on digits.

modes.label: Times per day or week
modes.description: A number word giving how often a dose is given.
modes.example: Administer at least<< four>> times daily and as needed

modes.label: Multiples of a dose
modes.description: A number word giving how many times the recommended dose or an increase, as in 'four to nine times'.

modes.label: Number of tablets
modes.description: A number word in parentheses giving how many tablets or caplets make a dose.

card.writes: It favors number-word endings such as 'fold' and 'teen', which fit a spelled-out number or multiple.
card.plain: It marks a spelled-out number like four or six in a dose, a count of tablets, or a multiple.
